## Summary

Describe the problem and the solution in a few sentences.

## Type of change

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Test or tooling

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] Relevant roles and routes were tested
- [ ] Screenshots are included for visible UI changes
- [ ] No credentials, NID values, customer data, or private documents are included

## Notes for reviewers

Call out migrations, environment changes, security implications, or follow-up work.
